build.title: Banner text on one line: every banner title and entry, full text on hover

said.text: Seven console banner plugins (activity, approvals, build manager, Claude handoff, codebase changes, push, systems check) keep their title line and every entry on one line, long text cut with an ellipsis; the shared BannerFrame shows cut text whole on hover. Branch claude/banner-one-line. Built on Opus (override of the Go pass rule, Brett).
